title: Where it can run: a hold only before the call
lede: A hold can only happen before the call is made. Rules that read inspection findings run after the request has been examined or after the reply has come back: refuse the call, or withhold the result. There is no arrow from either inspection to a hold, because neither can pause for a person. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Before the call: four layers and the two questions
Hold: reference and expiry, retry later

steps.title: The call arrives
steps.what: Token verified, then the four scope checks and the attended and unattended questions: everything that can allow, deny or hold happens here.

steps.title: A hold is possible only here
steps.what: Allow then deny holds the call for a person before anything is sent upstream.

steps.title: Allowed: the request is examined
steps.what: The examined request has findings (a card number, an instruction override, a secret).

steps.title: A finding refuses the call
steps.what: The choice at this point is to refuse. There is no hold: a rule that tries is refused when it is saved.

steps.title: No finding: the call is made
A finding withholds the result
steps.what: The call already happened; the result is withheld. Again, no hold.
